author: /root/restart_geometric_model
claim: Actual fifth norm-clutched O-module lines, trivializations and genuine gauge isomorphisms

obligations.name: Hypotheses
obligations.binding: Actual schemes, specified opens with proven source/target covers, and literal invertible transition functions. Generic gauge isomorphisms require the exact full-overlap multiplier identity.

obligations.name: Objects
obligations.binding: Genuine X.Modules objects are categorical pullbacks of the original pushed-forward chart unit modules. No Picard-class alias is substituted.

obligations.name: Coverage
obligations.binding: Both actual fifth target chart opens cover, and their whole source inverse images cover. Generic trivialization uses the same cover, including empty overlaps without an extra nonempty assumption.

obligations.name: Maps
obligations.binding: Actual whole-chart module frames, original coefficient maps, module restriction functors and original presheaf norm/cocycle maps are retained.

obligations.name: Coefficients
obligations.binding: Target transition and both gauge multipliers are exactly the norms of the original source units. Compatible coefficients satisfy left = right times transition.

obligations.name: Identities
obligations.binding: Genuine local/global trivialization inverse witnesses, all three categorical gauge component squares, both original coefficient projection squares, gauge preservation and eighth-power transition-line identity.

obligations.name: Local/global
obligations.binding: The original unit-to-line map is identified with the map reconstructed from covering restrictions before isomorphism is inferred. Gauge isomorphisms instead use the actual pullback map and three invertible component maps.

obligations.name: Evidence
obligations.binding: Nine final sources strictly pass; target-only private-inclusive recursive audit94/9 passes. Per-module mixed-log provenance and exact predecessor receipt/source hashes are retained.

obligations.name: Boundary
obligations.binding: Specified cover-dependent line objects and actual gauge isomorphisms only. No arbitrary source line classification, cover-independent Picard norm, tensor-power line isomorphism, Jacobian/polarization/PEL or self-acceptance.
